text.description_html:
Don-Jo PP-3.5x22-613, 3-1/2" x 22" Oil Rubbed Bronze Door Push Plate with Beveled Edge

The 3.5 x 22 Inch Oil Rubbed Bronze Push Plate with Beveled Edge is made out of solid bronze. The beveled edge adds a nice finishing touch. After all, it is the details that make the room!

Specifications of the Don-Jo PP-3.5x22-613 Oil Rubbed Bronze Push Plate:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Plate Height: 22"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Solid Bronze
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Sold Individually
